wrapperClocks.scope: Observed outer command/publisher wall clocks, including protocol, tooling, wait and publication. Union removes overlap only; not CPU time, billable time or a complete engineering clock.

actualManagedClocks.scope: Original managed attempt invocation clocks. Separate overlapping lane inside wrappers; never add this to wrapper totals.

explicitlyRecordedQueueWaits.scope: Only original explicit acquisition waits; deduplicated by acquired-at/profile. A subset of these waits lies inside the managed and wrapper clocks. Excludes currently unacquired waits and absent records; never add to their elapsed totals.

units: Original wall-clock seconds and minutes; not CPU time, billing or a causal speedup.
method: Closed interval sum plus sorted interval union; original managed attempts and acquisition events retain their own evidence hashes. Queue events deduplicate on acquired-at/profile. These lanes overlap and are not additive.
limits: Bounded current workline outputs only; not all past goal work or every repair cost.
